hook: Your plan isn't too small. It's too big for a bad day.

chapter: The Price Tag You Keep Avoiding
hook: You want everything.

Visualization isn't magic.
Running 25 km once impresses for one afternoon.
The spark was never missing. You stopped striking it.
The person you can't stand is the one you're becoming.

You can't fight doubt forever.
Your bookshelf isn't progress.

Motivation will leave you.
